text:
Scuttling in lightless tunnels and pitch black streams that crisscross the Umbrawells caverns, the skith are a true survivor in a bleak 
underground existence. Th is opportunist omnivore is often found scraping off the sulfur-based microbial mats that grow along the 
deep waterways. When sensing live prey, it quickly abandons the poor fare and crawls on the ceilings and walls in pursuit. When ready 
to close in, it uses its long powerful tail to launch itself into its prey. When pouncing his crustacean becomes a truly unseen horror, 
as its body violently slams into the creature, dozens of scything claws cutting through flesh, while it coils its chitinous tail around the 
body,squeezing the life out of it while it bleeds out in the oppressive darkness.

Actions
Multiattack Th e skith makes two attacks, it can use its Pincers 
or Forked Whip attacks in any combination.
Pincers Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 12 
(2d8+3) Slashing damage. If the skith jumped + 10 ft. toward the 
target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 
(1d8) Slashing damage. 
Forked Whip Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 5 (1d8 +5) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 12, 
one Medium or smaller creature that the skith has successfully 
hit with its Forked Whip. Failure: Th e target has the Prone 
condition.
Amphibious Th e skith can breathe both air and water.
Coiled Leap Th e skith’s long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump 
is up to 10 ft., and can be launched from any solid surface without 
the need of a running start.
Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Passive Perception 12, Tremorsense 30 ft.
Challenge 2 (XP 450; PB 2)
Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When an enemy creature within melee 
combat range of it is Blooded.
On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 14, the skith. Success: Th e 
skith attacks the nearest enemy creature with melee attack range 
with its Pincers attack as a Bonus Action. 
Skills Perception +2, Stealth +4

Encountering While content enough to feast on bacterial mats 
in the darkness, once they taste blood in the water or sense 
the rhythmic sound of movement, they will quickly abandon 
their simple meal for fresh meat. A Traveler willing to attract 
the crustaceans can easily pound the cavern walls to get their 
attention, but be warned, as there are more skith in the tunnels 
than one would expect could be contained within these tight 
twisting confi nes.
Dozens of segmented finned legs help 
the skith quickly navigate the water 
and tight confines of the deep tunnels. 
Gills run along the underside of each 
limb, their constant motion circulating 
the water so the crustacean can easily 
breathe within the stagnant acidic water
Coiling the long sinuous tail, the crustacean is 
able to catapult itself off walls and ceilings to 
collide with prey in a flurry of bladed limbs
A third naupliar eye sits on the 
armored plate of the crustacean’s 
head, primarily used to sense light 
and the tell-tale glow of nutrient 
rich bio luminescent fungi
